about: Blind holdout set for the phone-location capability, written 2026-10-12 from a short brief only, without opening the bridge source, the tools, or any prompt or tool description. Every case is the first message of a fresh chat sent from the owner's iPhone and is scored on the first capability the assistant reaches for; when the assistant reads the phone location and then does something else, it is scored on that second action. Three groups: 20 cases (ids 1-20, no group field) where the phone's location itself is the answer, so the primary is phone_location; 6 cases (ids 21-26, no group field) where the location only feeds another action, so the primary is that action and expect lists the other acceptable labels; and 6 hard negatives (ids 27-32, group hard_negative) that use location words but must never be answered by reading the phone's location. All places and phrasing are generic; no real personal places, names or addresses.
